def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    equity_value = 2_000_000
    debt_value = 1_000_000
    equity_cost = 0.08
    after_tax_debt_cost = 0.04

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_value = equity_value + debt_value
    equity_weight = equity_value / total_value
    debt_weight = debt_value / total_value

    wacc = (equity_weight * equity_cost) + (debt_weight * after_tax_debt_cost)
    answer = round(wacc * 100, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
